mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refrigerators (user_id, refrigerator_name) SELECT #{userId}, '내 냉장고' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refrigerators WHERE user_id = #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT refrigerator_id FROM refrigerators WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY refrigerator_id LIMIT 1

SELECT item_id AS id, refrigerator_id AS refrigeratorId, item_name AS name, category, quantity, quantity_unit AS unit, expiration_date AS expirationDate, storage_location AS storageLocation, memo, created_at AS createdAt FROM refrigerator_items WHERE item_id = #{id}
mapper.sql: i.item_id AS id, i.refrigerator_id AS refrigeratorId, i.item_name AS name, i.category, i.quantity, i.quantity_unit AS unit, i.expiration_date AS expirationDate, i.storage_location AS storageLocation, i.memo, i.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM refrigerator_items i JOIN refrigerators r ON r.refrigerator_id = i.refrigerator_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.item_id DESC
SELECT FROM refrigerator_items i JOIN refrigerators r ON r.refrigerator_id = i.refrigerator_id WHERE i.item_id = #{id} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE refrigerator_items i JOIN refrigerators r ON r.refrigerator_id = i.refrigerator_id SET i.item_name = #{item.name}, i.category = #{item.category}, i.quantity = #{item.quantity}, i.quantity_unit = #{item.unit}, i.expiration_date = #{item.expirationDate}, i.storage_location = #{item.storageLocation}, i.memo = #{item.memo} WHERE i.item_id = #{item.id} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE l FROM refrigerator_item_logs l JOIN refrigerator_items i ON i.item_id = l.item_id JOIN refrigerators r ON r.refrigerator_id = i.refrigerator_id WHERE i.item_id = #{id} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
